title: Health-Tech Platform
description: Real-time patient monitoring dashboard with 8+ device integrations. HIPAA-compliant architecture serving 50,000+ users.
fullDescription: We built a comprehensive telemedicine platform that enables healthcare providers to monitor patient vitals in real-time. The platform integrates with 8+ health devices including blood pressure monitors, glucose meters, and wearables to provide a complete picture of patient health.
challenge: The client needed to scale their telemedicine platform from serving a small pilot group to handling nationwide demand. They required real-time data synchronization from multiple health devices, HIPAA compliance, and the ability to handle sudden traffic spikes.
solution: We architected a microservices-based platform using Node.js for high-concurrency data processing. WebSocket connections enable real-time updates while Redis handles caching and pub/sub for instant notifications. PostgreSQL with proper indexing ensures fast queries even at scale.
results: Scaled from 10,000 to 500,000 active users
Integrated 8 different health device APIs (iHealth, Garmin, Fitbit, Dexcom, etc.)
Achieved 99.9% uptime with zero HIPAA violations
Reduced average page load time to under 1 second
Enabled real-time vitals monitoring with less than 100ms latency

testimonial.quote: ARSTEG transformed our vision into a platform that's now used by half a million patients. Their engineering expertise in healthcare tech is unmatched.
testimonial.author: Chief Technology Officer

title: E-Commerce Platform
description: Multi-vendor marketplace handling 100K+ daily transactions. Integrated payments, inventory management, and real-time analytics.
fullDescription: A full-featured multi-vendor marketplace that connects thousands of sellers with millions of buyers. The platform handles complex inventory management, real-time pricing, and seamless payment processing across multiple payment gateways.
challenge: The client's existing e-commerce platform was struggling with performance issues during peak traffic, cart abandonment due to slow checkout, and difficulty onboarding new vendors. They needed a complete overhaul to support their growth ambitions.
solution: We rebuilt the platform using Next.js for fast, SEO-friendly pages and .NET Core for robust backend services. Elasticsearch powers lightning-fast product search, while Redis caching ensures snappy response times. Stripe integration provides reliable payment processing with fraud protection.
results: 3x increase in revenue within first year
Processed over $10M in transactions monthly
Reduced cart abandonment by 40%
Achieved sub-2-second page load times
Onboarded 500+ new vendors in 3 months

testimonial.quote: The new platform has completely transformed our business. We went from struggling with daily crashes to processing 100,000 orders a day without breaking a sweat.
testimonial.author: CEO

title: Insurance Portal
description: Legacy system modernization for a 15-year-old insurance platform. Cloud migration with zero downtime.
fullDescription: Complete modernization of a legacy insurance platform built on Classic ASP and VB6. We migrated the entire system to a modern cloud-native architecture while ensuring business continuity throughout the transition.
challenge: A 15-year-old insurance platform built on deprecated technology was becoming impossible to maintain. Finding developers was nearly impossible, and every change carried significant risk. The client needed to modernize without disrupting their 24/7 operations.
solution: We employed the Strangler Fig pattern, gradually replacing legacy components with modern microservices. Azure Kubernetes Service provided scalable, containerized deployment. RabbitMQ enabled asynchronous processing of claims and policies. Both systems ran in parallel during the transition.
results: 80% improvement in application performance
40% reduction in infrastructure costs
Zero downtime during the entire migration
Deployment frequency increased from monthly to daily
Developer productivity increased 3x

testimonial.quote: We thought modernizing our legacy system would be a nightmare. ARSTEG made it seamless. Our team can finally ship features without fear.
testimonial.author: VP of Engineering

title: AI Document Processor
description: Intelligent document processing system using GPT-4 and computer vision. Reduced manual processing by 90%.
fullDescription: An AI-powered document processing system that automatically extracts, categorizes, and processes information from various document types including invoices, contracts, and forms. The system combines large language models with computer vision for unprecedented accuracy.
challenge: The enterprise client was processing thousands of documents daily with a large manual team. Errors were common, turnaround was slow, and costs were escalating. They needed an intelligent system that could understand and process documents with human-like accuracy.

results: 90% reduction in manual document processing
Processed over 1 million documents in first year
95% accuracy on automated extractions
10x faster processing compared to manual handling
ROI achieved within 4 months of deployment
